verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item API operations, such as creating a single order transaction or submitting a product_tax_code per line_item. Nothing shows a bulk or batch endpoint, or any multi-item operation across many records at once. Bulk operations are a fair axis for a SaaS tax platform with an API, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
